te: Ulrika Eleonora, Queen of Sweden abdicates in favour of her husband, who becomes King Frederick I on March 24.
dz: 乌尔丽卡·埃莱奥诺拉(瑞典语:Ulrika Eleonora),瑞典女王,放弃支持她的丈夫,她于3月24日成为弗雷德里克一世国王.
de: Ulrika Eleonora, Queen of Sweden abdicates in favour of her husband, who becomes King Frederick I on March 24.

te: Count Frederick of Hesse-Kassel is elected King of Sweden by the Riksdag of the Estates, after his consort Ulrika Eleon…
dz: 黑塞-卡塞尔的弗雷德里克伯爵被庄园议会选举为瑞典国王,此前他的同党乌尔丽卡·埃莱奥诺拉于2月29日放弃了王位.
de: Count Frederick of Hesse-Kassel is elected King of Sweden by the Riksdag of the Estates, after his consort Ulrika Eleonora abdicated the throne on 29 February.

de: The Spanish military Villasur expedition is defeated by Pawnee and Otoe warriors near present-day Columbus, Nebraska.
